review_evidence: README identifies the repository as tooling for extracting declaration types, premises, goal/tactic pairs, comments, InfoTrees, and tactic benchmarks from Lean libraries for machine-learning/training use.

Direct inspection of the production modules found Lean frontend/InfoTree traversal, JSON serialization, CLI/data-export plumbing, and metaprogramming helpers rather than an independently specified or proved mathematical/semantic development.

A complete proposition-pattern scan found only a trivial True fixture, a one-line transitivity calc example, and text of a Mathlib theorem embedded inside the training_data CLI help example; there is no project theorem/lemma/axiom corpus establishing correctness of the extraction tools.

source_action.content_invariant: The repository implements frontend traversal, InfoTree processing, serialization, and training-data/benchmark command-line tools; its only proposition examples are trivial fixtures or quoted help text, so retirement hides no unique mathematical statement, proof, specification, or verified semantics.
